gloss: delivery; something delivered; gift sent to someone

definitions.gloss: delivery; something delivered; gift sent to someone
definitions.explanation: An item that is delivered or sent to someone, often a gift or package. Implies a personal or thoughtful delivery rather than commercial shipping.

examples.japanese: {届|とど}け{物|もの}が{届|とど}いた。
{隣|となり}の{家|いえ}に{届|とど}け{物|もの}をした。
examples.english: I made a delivery to the neighboring house.

examples.japanese: {母|はは}から{届|とど}け{物|もの}が{届|とど}いたので、{中身|なかみ}を{確認|かくにん}した。
examples.english: A package arrived from my mother, so I checked what was inside.

notes:
Refers to something delivered to a person, often with a nuance of personal care or thoughtfulness. While {荷物|にもつ} is a neutral word for a package or parcel, {届|とど}け{物|もの} suggests something specifically intended for the recipient.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {届|とど}け{物|もの}をする: to make a delivery
- {届|とど}け{物|もの}が{届|とど}く: a delivery arrives
- {届|とど}け{物|もの}を{預|あず}かる: to hold a delivery (for someone)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {荷物|にもつ}: package, parcel — neutral term for any shipped item
- {贈|おく}り{物|もの}: gift — emphasizes the gift-giving aspect
- {届|とど}け{物|もの} falls between the two, covering both deliveries and personal gifts sent to someone

FORMS:
{届|とど}ける (to deliver) + {物|もの} (thing)
